name: scene_clapper
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original Oathroll game art, Ledger & Lamplight. Painterly cinematic dark fantasy, rich oil-paint surfaces and bold deliberate brush masses, strong value contrast, readable silhouettes, restrained texture without film grain or tiny noise. Ink #14110F, Soot #221C18, Vellum #EDE3CF, faded ink #8A7F70, vermilion wax #B8322A, gilt #C9A24A, verdigris #3E8E7E; cold sea-blue darkness against one warm candlelight source. Eerie, melancholy, wondrous, never gory. Entirely original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, writing, typographic runes, logos or watermarks; any ledger pages are completely blank and wax seals bear only a plain abstract circle.
Asset type: narrative beat 4, landscape 16:9 highest available resolution ideally 3840x2160. Intimate cinematic view upward into the great aged bronze bell inside the drowned belfry. A single beautifully plain silver clapper, a long tapered metal shaft ending in a rounded pear-shaped striking bulb, hangs vertically at centre-right inside the bell's immense dark mouth. No filigree, symbols or inscriptions. Wren's leather-gloved hand reaches from lower left toward the silver clapper; only arm and edge of soot sleeve with a small muted vermilion scarf fold visible. A single candle in a brass lantern on a stone ledge at lower right brings warm gold reflection to one side of the silver; cold moonlight and sea-glass reflections on the other. Through a distant pointed opening at left see the dark moonlit sea. Treasure is tangible, reflective, dramatically lit. Broad dark quiet area at upper left for UI.
